# Rangular

> The Rangular framework is a standalone transpiler: you write Angular-style code, TypeScript classes with @Component decorators and HTML-like templates, and it compiles to React Native .tsx (Hermes makes the bytecode; Rangular never emits it, never forks Angular). Simple template blocks compile to pre-polished Rangular Material primitives driven by design tokens, state is plain class fields (mutated fields become useState in the generated output), and every compiler error is a coded diagnostic with a concrete fix suggestion. Current state: all planned stages are complete, Stages 0 to 12 (Stages 0 to 5 were the v1 core), plus Stage 13 (stack sections, opt-in app bar furniture, text buttons, icon buttons), Stage 14 (the ten Angular Material pieces the audit found missing: menu, select, drawer, stepper, grid list, tree, divider, tooltip, and table sorting and pagination) and Stage 15 (version 0.1.2, the 0.1.1 stage set plus the file picker dependency fix; the twenty pieces real apps use that Angular never shipped: bottom navigation, pull to refresh, infinite scroll, skeletons, swipe row actions, file and image picker, input masks, star rating, OTP input, carousel, timeline, calendar month view, avatars, empty state, charts, a marked-up text editor, image and lightbox, masonry grid mode, colour picker, breadcrumbs). The surface: static components, {{ interpolation }}, [prop] bindings, (event) bindings, *ngIf, *ngFor, interactive previews, the vibe-coding layer (this file, AGENTS.md, generated catalog, recipe cards, --json diagnostics), child components with @Input/@Output, @Injectable services with constructor DI, lifecycle hooks, HttpClient on fetch, the complete token set with light/dark theming and CSS value snapping, and the full CLI (build, ast, preview, catalog, watch, init, doctor) with per-file diagnostics and block level source maps; Stage 6 Material style controls (switch, checkbox, segmented page switcher, radio group); the Stage 7 icon set (one <icon> block, 27 curated Material style icons, compile time name validation); Stage 8 forms the Angular way (an <input> block compiling to the RgInput primitive, [(ngModel)] two-way binding on inputs with attribute validators and #name="ngModel" template refs, a lightweight <form (submit)> element, and reactive FormGroup/FormControl/Validators classes); Stage 9 routing (a Routes array in app.routes.ts or via --routes, one <router-outlet> in the root component, routerLink in string and array forms, ActivatedRoute snapshot/paramMap and the Router service over a runtime RgNavigator and matchRoute); Stage 10 pickers and overlays (an iOS wheel <datetime-picker> in a bottom sheet on every platform, declarative <sheet> and <dialog> blocks with an <actions> row, and a built-in SnackBar service whose open() returns a ref with onAction); Stage 11 data display (tabs that own their content panels, single-open accordion expansion panels, a declarative table with named columns, autocomplete on <input>, a slider, progress bar and spinner, chips, and matBadge as a badge attribute on button, row and icon); Stage 12 language completeness and app readiness (the full built-in pipe set with custom @Pipe classes, attribute directives in a style-only subset, single-slot content projection, a runnable Expo app scaffold via init --app, and the closing security re-audit). Design principle: the preview is a promise, any code that is successful as a mobile responsive must be successful as an app; if it works at phone width in the preview, the same generated code must work as a real React Native app. See the delta summary below for what is NOT supported yet.

## The delta in 30 seconds

Same as Angular: @Component/@Input/@Output, separate .html templates, {{ }} / [ ] / ( ) / *ngIf / *ngFor syntax, class fields as state, methods as actions, built-in pipes (the full set: uppercase, lowercase, titlecase, json, date, number, percent, currency, slice, keyvalue, async) and custom @Pipe classes imported by the component. Stage 6 controls mirror Angular Material: switch (mat-slide-toggle), checkbox (mat-checkbox), switcher with option children (mat-button-toggle-group), radio-group with radio children (mat-radio-group); each takes [checked] or [value] and emits the next value through (change) as $event for a method to assign. The switcher is view state inside one screen, not routing. Icons: <icon name="search"> draws from a fixed set of 27 Material style icons (SVG path data in packages/ui/src/icons.ts); size is 20, 24 or 28 (default 24), color names a theme colour role; an unknown static name is a compile error (GEN_ICON_UNKNOWN) whose JSON diagnostic carries the valid list in validIcons; the app draws with react-native-svg (ships in Expo Go), the preview draws the same path data inline. Child components resolve by import (a template tag matching an imported component's selector compiles to it); @Output EventEmitter.emit becomes a callback prop (onSaved). @Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' }) services + constructor parameter-property DI work, services are reactive singletons, ngOnInit/ngOnDestroy are wired to useEffect, and HttpClient.get(url).subscribe(data => { ... }) works with the block-bodied-arrow shape.
Forms (Stage 8): <input> compiles to RgInput (label, placeholder, error line, [disabled], type="password|email|number" for secure entry and keyboards). [(ngModel)]="field" on <input> only is a real two-way binding (value plus write-back setter); the [ngModel] + (ngModelChange) pair works too; ngModel elsewhere is a GEN_NGMODEL_TARGET error. Validators are attributes (required, minlength, maxlength, email, pattern) with Angular error shapes; type="email" does NOT imply the email validator. #email="ngModel" exposes valid/invalid/touched/errors to template expressions only. <form (submit)="save()"> is a wrapper whose <button type="submit"> runs the handler after marking inputs touched; there is no NgForm object. Reactive forms: FormGroup/FormControl/Validators imported from @angular/forms are runtime classes; a group field is a stable ref-held instance bound with [formGroup] and formControlName, and profileForm.get('email') evaluates in templates. Full boundaries in the Forms section of docs/VIBE_CODING.md.
Routing (Stage 9): routes live in app.routes.ts next to the root component (or the file named by --routes), as export const routes: Routes = [...] in the modern standalone form (the provideRouter array, not RouterModule.forRoot). Entries are { path, component }, { path, redirectTo, pathMatch: 'full' } and { path: '**', component }; :param captures one segment as a string; data/title keys are accepted and ignored. The root template holds one <router-outlet>; route components are ordinary imported components with no props from the shell. routerLink="/inbox" and [routerLink]="['/mail', m.id]" on <button>/<row>/<fab> compile to a navigation press (array literals are in the expression subset). ActivatedRoute and Router are built-in injections: snapshot.params is a plain string map, paramMap is an Observable-lite, router.navigate([...]) and navigateByUrl(url) resolve from the root. Same-component param changes remount in v1. No child routes, guards, resolvers, lazy loading or routerLinkActive: an entry using one is a GEN_ROUTE_UNSUPPORTED error; no routes file is GEN_ROUTES_MISSING; an unknown component is GEN_ROUTE_COMPONENT; a repeated path warns GEN_ROUTE_DUPLICATE. The preview navigates fully and shows a preview-only Back bar at depth 2+. Full boundaries in the Routing section of docs/VIBE_CODING.md.
Pickers and overlays (Stage 10): PRODUCT RULE, the <datetime-picker> is the iOS wheel picker on every platform, wheels inside a bottom sheet, never a calendar grid and never an Android style dialog. Modes: date (month, day, year wheels), time (hour 1 to 12, minute, AM/PM), datetime (the default: one combined date wheel plus hour, minute, AM/PM). [value] takes an ISO string or a Date; Done emits (change) once with the composed ISO string as $event, Cancel discards. minuteInterval is 1 or 5; anything else warns GEN_PICKER_INTERVAL and snaps. An unknown static mode is a GEN_PICKER_MODE error. Date years run value year -25 to +25; the datetime date wheel spans 183 days either side of the value. <sheet [open]="x" (close)="closeSheet()"> and <dialog [open]="x" (close)="closeDialog()" title="..."> are the declarative adaptations of MatBottomSheet and MatDialog: children render inside the panel, dialog buttons usually sit in an <actions> row, a backdrop tap emits (close), and no [open] means statically open plus a GEN_OVERLAY_OPEN warning. EVENT BINDINGS NEVER HOLD ASSIGNMENTS: (close)="x = false" warns GEN_EVENT_ASSIGNMENT and is dropped; call a method and assign inside it. SnackBar is imported with `import { SnackBar } from '@angular/material/snack-bar';` and is a built-in component injection: open(message, actionLabel?, durationMs = 4000) returns a ref; the supported action form is const ref = this.snack.open('Deleted', 'Undo'); ref.onAction(() => { ... }); with a block body. Opening replaces the current bar. A service injecting SnackBar gets DI_UNKNOWN_TOKEN. In the preview the wheels are clickable lists with the same selected value outcome. Full boundaries in the Pickers and overlays section of docs/VIBE_CODING.md.
Data display (Stage 11): <tabs [index]="i" (change)="onTab($event)"> holds <tab label="..."> children whose template children render only while selected; tabs own content panels, the Stage 6 <switcher> is a bare control with no panels, do not confuse them. <panel title subtitle> is self-managed (tap toggles, [expanded] is only the starting seed, (toggle) emits the next boolean as $event); <accordion> around direct panels is single-open like mat-accordion with multi false. <table [data]="rows"> takes <column name="prop" header="Text"> children (name is the matColumnDef name; key is an accepted alias because React reserves key); cells are String(value), no column templates, no sorting or pagination; empty data shows nothing unless the table has an emptyText attribute. Autocomplete: <input [(ngModel)]="city" [options]="cities" (optionSelected)="onCity($event)"> lists string options filtered by case-insensitive substring while focused; a pick writes back through ngModel and emits the string; object options and displayWith are not supported. <slider min max step [value] (change)> snaps and clamps (static min >= max is a GEN_SLIDER_RANGE error); <progress-bar [value]> clamps 0 to 100 (GEN_PROGRESS_RANGE) and mode="indeterminate" is a static 40 percent bar in the preview; <spinner> size rides the icon scale (GEN_SPINNER_SIZE) and its arc is static in the preview. <chip icon="star" removable (remove)="m(f)"> in a <chips> row; removing a list chip works with this.filters = this.filters.filter(...) in a method, and adding works by assignment too: this.items = [...this.items, item], or this.items = this.items.concat(item). List state always changes by assigning a new array: push, pop and shift written as plain statements are translated for you (push becomes a concat setter call, pop and shift become slice setter calls), while splice, unshift, sort, reverse, fill, and pop or shift whose return value is used, warn METHOD_UNSUPPORTED with the assignment form as the fix. badge="3" or [badge]="n" is an attribute on <button>, <row> and <icon> only: 0 or empty renders nothing, above 99 renders 99+, other hosts warn GEN_BADGE_HOST. Misplaced declarations (tab outside tabs, column outside table, non-panel in accordion) warn GEN_CONTROL_NESTING. Full boundaries in the Data display section of docs/VIBE_CODING.md.
Pipes, directives, projection (Stage 12): built-in pipes take Angular argument shapes: {{ day | date:'shortDate' }} or a custom format string with tokens yyyy MM dd HH mm ss hh a; {{ amount | number:'1.2-2' }} uses digitsInfo (min integer, min fraction, max fraction), percent multiplies by 100 and appends %, currency:'USD' prefixes one of the USD/EUR/GBP/INR/NPR symbols (an unknown code prints the code); slice works on strings and arrays with negative indexes; keyvalue turns an object into { key, value } entries sorted by key for *ngFor. {{ stream$ | async }} renders the latest emitted value starting from null: stream a stable field or a service property assigned in the service constructor (the expression is captured at mount). A custom pipe is a @Pipe({ name: 'exclaim' }) class with a transform method; the component imports it like a child or service, and an unregistered name is a PIPE_UNKNOWN error listing the known pipes. In the preview static paint only single-return transforms in the template expression subset evaluate; the interactive page and the app run the full body. Attribute directives: @Directive({ selector: '[appHighlight]' }) with @Input fields and an injected ElementRef, logic in ngOnInit or a setter, body restricted to this.el.nativeElement.style.<prop> = <expr over inputs and literals> statements; the compiler folds them into the host's style (binding, then static attribute, then declared default); anything else warns DIR_UNSUPPORTED, including directives on child component tags. Content projection: children written inside a child component tag render where the child places <ng-content></ng-content>, evaluated in the parent's scope; a select attribute warns PROJECTION_SELECT_UNSUPPORTED and acts as the default slot. Expo scaffold: rangular init <name> --app creates a real Expo app (bare names land in the checkout's apps/ folder; package.json carries the Expo SDK 58 pins and file: deps to this checkout's packages; the starter is compiled into src/AppRoot.tsx at init time); run it with npm install and npx expo start in Expo Go. Verified structurally and by compilation, not device-tested in the build environment; the hardware back button is not wired to the navigator in this version. Full boundaries in the Pipes, Attribute directives, Content projection and Expo app scaffold sections of docs/VIBE_CODING.md.
NOT supported yet (do not use): two-way binding beyond [(ngModel)] ([(x)] on anything else degrades to a one-way prop binding), NgModules, animations, SSR, full RxJS (HttpClient returns an Observable-lite with subscribe only, no operators), multi-slot projection, *ngIf else/then (use two elements with opposite conditions), CSS beyond the element/.class subset.
Not React: no JSX, no hooks, no useState in source, source is classes + HTML templates; events are (click), never onPress; the generated .tsx is output, never edited. Full tables: [docs/VIBE_CODING.md](docs/VIBE_CODING.md).

## Examples (each has a recipe card)

- [Hello - recipe card](examples/hello/README.md): Static screen, {{ interpolation }}, [prop] binding, component styles, the smallest Rangular component
- [Counter - recipe card](examples/counter/README.md): Events + state, (click) handlers, methods mutating fields become useState, *ngIf message
- [Inbox - recipe card](examples/inbox/README.md): Lists, *ngFor over a literal array with keyed rows, *ngIf empty state
- [Profile - recipe card](examples/profile/README.md): Composition, card + avatar row + toggle button with ternary label + posts list; the Stage 2.5 proof-test example, written from these docs alone
- [Favourite - recipe card](examples/favourite/README.md): Child components, @Input props with defaults, @Output EventEmitter -> callback prop, parent handler with $event, children under *ngFor
- [Shared inbox - recipe card](examples/shared-inbox/README.md): Services + DI + lifecycle, one MailService singleton injected into a screen and a child badge, reactive via ReactiveService/__notify, ngOnInit -> useEffect
- [Showcase - recipe card](examples/showcase/README.md): Theming and tokens, one screen with every text variant, card, buttons, avatar list, badge and FAB; token scales, <screen theme="dark">, CSS snapping (STYLE_OFF_SCALE), the preview Light/Dark toggle
- [Dinacharya row - recipe card](examples/dinacharya-row/README.md): The dogfood example, one real Awaken Me Dinacharya block row (34 by 34 gold check square, title, time range, pieces line, tap toggles the featured block), brand colours with the doctor allow-hex suppression, and an honest list of what is simplified versus the real app
- [Settings - recipe card](examples/settings/README.md): Stage 6 controls, a Wi-Fi switch, a Notifications checkbox, a List and Statistics switcher that swaps the panel below it with *ngIf, and a radio group for text size; Material correspondence for each control and the switch knob motion rule
- [Icons - recipe card](examples/icons/README.md): Stage 7 icons, the full 27 icon set with a name label under each (icons inside *ngFor), a usage strip with sizes and colour roles, the unknown-name error with its validIcons list, and the react-native-svg app requirement
- [Signup form - recipe card](examples/signup-form/README.md): Stage 8 template-driven forms, a create account form with [(ngModel)], attribute validators, #name="ngModel" refs driving the error lines and the submit button, and a terms checkbox on the Stage 6 (change) pattern
- [Profile form - recipe card](examples/profile-form/README.md): Stage 8 reactive forms, a FormGroup built in the class, [formGroup] and formControlName bindings, errors read through profileForm.get('email'), and a submit handler that prints the form value as JSON
- [Mini Mail - recipe card](examples/mini-mail/README.md): Stage 9 routing, a shell with <router-outlet>, routes in app.routes.ts ('' redirects to inbox, mail/:id detail, ** not-found), rows navigating with [routerLink] arrays, ActivatedRoute snapshot params over a shared MailService, and a deliberately stale link proving the wildcard
- [Reminder - recipe card](examples/reminder/README.md): Stage 10 pickers and overlays, a reminder form with an iOS wheel datetime picker, a bottom sheet holding a repeat radio group, a confirm dialog with an actions row, and a SnackBar with an Undo action in the supported statement form
- [Mailbox Pro - recipe card](examples/mailbox-pro/README.md): Stage 11 data display, one mailbox screen with Inbox and Starred tabs, a single-open accordion (Storage quota with a progress bar, Sync with a spinner), a folders table, a move-to-folder autocomplete, a preview lines slider, removable filter chips, and unread badges on a row and a button
- [Pipes demo - recipe card](examples/pipes-demo/README.md): Stage 12 pipes, a built-ins tour (date, number, percent, currency, slice, keyvalue in *ngFor) plus one custom @Pipe (exclaim) imported by the component
- [Directives demo - recipe card](examples/directives-demo/README.md): Stage 12 attribute directives, the canonical HighlightDirective (appHighlight plus defaultColor) styling static and bound hosts, folded into the host style at compile time
- [Projection demo - recipe card](examples/projection-demo/README.md): Stage 12 content projection, a panel child whose <ng-content> slot receives the parent's heading, text and a working button
- [App Shell - recipe card](examples/app-shell/README.md): Stage 14 frame pieces, a drawer opened from the app bar menu button, a menu of message actions with a divider, and a three step checkout stepper
- [Explorer - recipe card](examples/explorer/README.md): Stage 14 data pieces, a select dropdown, a folder tree, a two column grid list, a sortable paged table, and a tooltip on the save button
- [Feed - recipe card](examples/feed/README.md): Stage 15 Tier 1, pull to refresh and infinite scroll on the screen, a loading skeleton card, swipe actions on mail rows, and a bottom navigation bar
- [Forms Plus - recipe card](examples/forms-plus/README.md): Stage 15 Tier 2, a masked phone input, a star rating, an OTP code input, a three page carousel, and a photo picker
- [Insights - recipe card](examples/insights/README.md): Stage 15 Tier 3, breadcrumbs, an avatar group, bar line and pie charts, a calendar month view, a timeline, a photo lightbox, a small editor, a colour picker, and a masonry grid

## Packages

- [@rangular/compiler](packages/compiler/src/index.ts): Compiler entry point, template/expression parsers, @Component extractor, CSS subset, codegen, preview renderer, catalog generator
- [@rangular/cli](packages/cli/src/cli.ts): The rangular CLI, build, ast, preview, catalog, watch, init, doctor; build/preview/doctor accept --json, build accepts --source-map, build/preview/watch/doctor accept --routes <file>
- [@rangular/runtime](packages/runtime/src/index.ts): Pure-TS helpers for generated apps, EventEmitter, signal(), DI Container, ReactiveService (service reactivity base class), HttpClient (Observable-lite over fetch), pipe(), Validators, validateValue, FormControl, FormGroup, RgNavigator, matchRoute, Router, ActivatedRoute, SnackBar, SnackBarRef
- [@rangular/ui tokens](packages/ui/src/tokens.ts): Rangular Material design tokens, spacing, radius, type scale, the full colour role set in light and dark, elevation presets, themes export
- [@rangular/ui primitives](packages/ui/src/primitives.tsx): Pre-polished RN primitives (RgScreen, RgAppbar, RgCard, RgButton, RgText, RgList, RgRow, RgFab, RgSwitch, RgCheckbox, RgSwitcher, RgOption, RgRadioGroup, RgRadio, RgIcon, RgInput, RgOutlet, RgSheet, RgDialog, RgActions, RgSnackbar, RgDateTimePicker, RgTabs, RgTab, RgAccordion, RgPanel, RgTable, RgColumn, RgSlider, RgProgressBar, RgSpinner, RgChips, RgChip, RgMenu, RgMenuItem, RgDrawer, RgSelect, RgStepper, RgStep, RgGridList, RgGridTile, RgTree, RgTreeNode, RgDivider, RgBottomNav, RgNavItem, RgSkeleton, RgRowAction, RgRating, RgOtp, RgFilePicker, RgColorPicker, RgEditor, RgCarousel, RgTimeline, RgTimelineItem, RgCalendar, RgAvatar, RgAvatarGroup, RgEmptyState, RgChart, RgImage, RgLightbox, RgBreadcrumbs, RgCrumb) shipped as source into generated apps
- [@rangular/ui mask](packages/ui/src/mask.ts): The input mask engine, a three character pattern language (9 digit, A letter, star any character) whose masked string is the model value; the preview page runtime mirrors it and the two are parity-tested
- [@rangular/ui chart](packages/ui/src/chart.ts): The chart geometry engine, bar line and pie shape models over label and value points, serialized identically by the app and both preview renderers; the page runtime mirrors it and the two are parity-tested
- [@rangular/ui palette](packages/ui/src/palette.ts): The fixed data colour palette charts and the colour picker share; data colours, not theme tokens, so they keep their identity across light and dark
- [@rangular/ui icons](packages/ui/src/icons.ts): The curated icon set as SVG path data (name to paths, 24 by 24 viewBox), the icon size scale (20, 24, 28) and the default size; compiler validation, the catalog and both renderers all read this one file
- [@rangular/ui datetime](packages/ui/src/datetime.ts): The picker's value model, ISO parsing and composition, leap correct month lengths, wheel specifications for the three modes and the display formatting; the preview page runtime mirrors it and the two are parity-tested
- [@rangular/ui README](packages/ui/README.md): What ships from the UI package and why primitives are excluded from the repo build

## How to build a screen

1. Write the component class: `x.component.ts` with `@Component({ selector: 'app-x', templateUrl: './x.component.html' })`, state as literal-initialised class fields, actions as methods that assign `this.field`. Shared state goes in an `@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })` service class, injected as a constructor parameter property (`constructor(private mail: MailService)`). Import the service (and any child component classes) in the component file; the compiler follows relative imports.
2. Write the template: `x.component.html` using only catalog tags, text in `p`/`span`/`h1`-`h3`, interaction via `(click)="method()"`, controls via `(change)="method($event)"` with the method assigning the emitted value, text entry via `<input>` with `[(ngModel)]="field"` for two-way binding (attribute validators, `#name="ngModel"` refs for validity in the template) or `formControlName` inside a `[formGroup]` form for reactive forms, a `<button type="submit">` inside `<form (submit)="method()">` to submit, icons via `<icon name="...">` with a name from the catalog's Icons list (size 20, 24 or 28; color naming a theme colour role), visibility via `*ngIf`, lists via `*ngFor="let item of items; let i = index"`. An `option` belongs only inside `switcher` and a `radio` only inside `radio-group`. A tag matching an imported child component's selector is a child component: `[input]="expr"` passes props, `(output)="handler($event)"` receives its EventEmitter emits. Put `theme="dark"` on `<screen>` to theme the whole screen dark (default light). For several screens, make the root component a shell whose template holds one `<router-outlet></router-outlet>`, declare the screens in `app.routes.ts` next to it (`export const routes: Routes = [...]`, route components imported there), and link with `routerLink="/path"` or `[routerLink]="['/path', value]"` on buttons and rows; a routed screen reads its parameters from an injected `ActivatedRoute` (`this.route.snapshot.params.id`, a string) and navigates from code with an injected `Router`. For a date or time, use `<datetime-picker mode="date|time|datetime" [value]="field" (change)="onWhen($event)">` (iOS wheels in a sheet on every platform); for overlays use `<sheet [open]="x" (close)="closeSheet()">` or `<dialog [open]="x" (close)="closeDialog()" title="...">` with buttons in an `<actions>` row, and never write an assignment in an event binding, call a method instead; for a toast, inject `SnackBar` in the component and call `this.snack.open('Saved')`. For data display, use `<tabs>` when each choice owns a content panel and `<table [data]>` with `<column name>` declarations for read-only grids, add `[options]` plus `(optionSelected)` to an `<input>` for autocomplete, and put counts on buttons, rows, icons and nav items with the `badge` attribute. For app chrome and the Stage 15 pieces: primary destinations go in `<bottom-nav>` of `<nav-item icon label>` declarations (the screen pins it), refresh and pagination are `[refreshing]`, `(refresh)` and `(endReached)` on `<screen>` or `<list>`, the extra controls are `<rating>`, `<otp length>`, `<color-picker>` and `<editor>` on the same [value] and (change) contract, a `<file-picker kind="image|file">` emits picked file info, `<input mask="(999) 999-9999">` formats its own value, and the display set is `<skeleton>`, `<carousel>`, `<timeline>` of `<timeline-item>` declarations, `<calendar>` (a month view, not the wheel picker), `<avatar>` and `<avatar-group>`, `<empty-state>`, `<chart type="bar|line|pie" [data]>` over `{ label, value }` points, `<image src width height>` (declared size is enforced by the doctor) with `<lightbox [open] (close)>`, `<grid-list mode="masonry">`, and `<breadcrumbs>` of `<crumb>` declarations. In component `styles`, spacing, border-radius and font-size values snap to the token scales (STYLE_OFF_SCALE warns and names the snapped value).
3. Compile: `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js build x.component.ts --out x.component.tsx --json` (add `--source-map` for a block level `.map` file). Or scaffold a whole starter project first: `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js init my-app`, or a runnable Expo app with `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js init my-app --app` (the app lands in the checkout's apps/ folder, then `npm install` and `npx expo start` inside it), and keep a screen rebuilding while you edit with `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js watch x.component.ts --out x.component.tsx`.
4. Read the diagnostics from the JSON: each has a `code`, source `line`/`column`, a `file` naming the file it belongs to (the .html for template problems, the .ts for class problems, the styles file for style problems), and a `fix`. Apply the fix to the source (never to the generated .tsx).
5. Render the preview: `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js preview x.component.ts --out preview.html`
6. Open `preview.html` and check the screen. It is interactive: (click) handlers run, *ngIf/*ngFor respond to state. Iterate from step 1.
7. Run the polish linter before calling it done: `node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js doctor x.component.ts` reports hex colours, off-scale values, loose text and small tap targets, each with a fix.
8. If the screen becomes a shipped example, it is not done until it also has: a recipe card (`examples/<name>/README.md` in the fixed Intent / Source / What it compiles to / Rules used / Common mistakes shape), tests, a regenerated catalog (`node dist/packages/cli/src/cli.js catalog --out .`), and a regenerated style snapshot (`examples/<name>/styles.snapshot.json`), see golden rule 2 in AGENTS.md.
